title: Version history
needsGit: History needs Git. Install Git for Windows to turn it on.
unavailable: Version history isn't available right now. Restart Second Brain; if it stays like this, look at the log folder in Settings.
noteMissing: Can't find the note {{title}} anymore. It may have been renamed or deleted.
offline: Can't reach the server. Please try again later.
loadFailed: Couldn't load the history. Press Try again.
empty: No versions saved yet. Second Brain saves a version every 10 minutes while the note changes.
versionFailed: Couldn't open this version. Select it again to retry.
versionMissing: This version is no longer in the history.
versionNotText: This version isn't readable text (not UTF-8), so it can't be compared.
confirm: Restore this version? The current text is replaced by the selected version and stays in the history.
restoreConflict: The note just changed. Open the history again to see the newest version.
restoreMissing: Couldn't restore: the note or this version no longer exists.
restoreFailed: Couldn't restore this version. Please try again.

diff.label: Differences between the current note and the selected version
diff.same: This version is the same as the current note.
